method: Pair flags -> prepare -> controller -> return -> unprepare by PID and actual cmd/ctrl pointers; omit RX and strip addresses. Compare ordered75 table records plus oneDBV write.
analysis_correction: Initial offline parser assumed prepare after controller and stopped before publishing; corrected to observed native event order. No device test repeated.
limits: No optical recording in this diagnostic; prior raw/UI optical difference is from separately saved captures.
Equality is for sampled fields/state, not full DMA contents, panel ACK, relative frame timing or pixel-frame updates.
No new panel profile or measured PWM frequency.
